steps.action: Press "Make a gym"; fill "Gym name", "Owner’s name", "Owner’s mobile" (10 digits)

user_sees: "The owner’s sign-in code (works once, for 30 minutes):" with the code, "Copy the message"
must_not: Two gyms made by one press

steps.action: Press "Make a gym for this lead"
user_sees: Card "Make a gym for this lead" with the gym name and mobile filled in
The code card; the lead moves to "demo" with the note "Gym made in HQ: <code>"
must_not: A lead already past "called" moved back to "demo"

steps.action: Press "Make the gym" with a 9-digit mobile
must_not: A gym made with a bad mobile

steps.action: Press it with an empty gym or owner name
Press "Make the gym" again on the same card
user_sees: A clear word that this gym exists already
must_not: A second gym with the same owner made with no warning
The new gym missing from the list

user_sees: "Send it on WhatsApp. It is not kept anywhere: copy it now."
The log keeps only the last 4 digits of the owner's mobile
must_not: The code readable later in HQ or in the log
The full mobile in the log

start: A gym that left a demo request on the landing page

user_sees: "MettleUp: your sign-in code for <gym> is <code>. Open the MettleUp admin app, type your mobile number and this code. It works once, for 30 minutes."
must_not: Another gym's name in the message

steps.action: Open the admin app, type the mobile and the code
user_sees: The new gym's admin app, signed in as owner
must_not: A sign-in to a gym of another owner

start: A gym owner who called MettleUp without a lead

steps.action: HQ makes the gym from "Make a gym" during the call and sends the code
must_not: A lead needed before a gym can be made

start: The code is late or used

steps.action: Type the code after 30 minutes, or a second time
user_sees: A refusal; ask MettleUp for a new code
must_not: A sign-in with an old code

start: The lead after the gym is made

must_not: The lead still "new", so it is called again

user_sees: Stored as the owner's sign-in number; used to call back about MettleUp
